story_name: Thoth's Knowledge: Wisdom as Recording and Transmission
character_description: Thoth, ibis-headed god with luminous white plumage catching light, brilliant golden eyes reflecting all knowledge, carrying sacred texts and measurement tools. His power comes from precision, documentation, and transmission of wisdom across time.
setting: Libraries and halls of knowledge, scales of cosmic justice, spaces where wisdom is preserved
theme: Understanding that wisdom's true power lies in accurate documentation and transmission to future generations

video_prompts: Thoth perceives that knowledge unrecorded is knowledge lost—begins sacred work of documenting all wisdom.
first_frame_prompt: Thoth manifests with ibis head held high, white plumage radiating pure clarity, golden eyes perceiving all knowledge. He recognizes terrifying truth—wisdom dies with those who hold it unless documented. He begins sacred work of recording, measuring, preserving. Every scroll he creates is act of infinite compassion toward future beings.
speech: Knowledge is only power if it is transmitted. Recording is sacred act.

His role is preservation of truth for all time. He learns that accurate recording is greatest service—not interpretation or bias, just clear documentation of what occurred.
speech: My role is to record truth perfectly. Let others draw conclusions.
